messages:
incident-bot: Pager: Dedicated pool 'dedicated-eu-1' high queue depth and streaming stalls > p99 threshold. Alert: tail_latency_p99 = 4800ms, p95 = 1200ms. Affected customers: 3 stable tenants (ids: cust-137, cust-482, cust-590).

oncall-sre-mike: Acked. I'm on it. Paging SRE channel and starting triage.

runtime-eng-sanjay: Seeing sustained queue depth ~ 420 requests across the pool, backlog growing for ~6min. Autoscaler logs show warmup handshakes delayed by 90-120s. Probable hotspot: cold pool warmup not completing before traffic shift.

infra-ashley: On the metric side: GPU utilization at 96% on the existing warm machines, cold pool instances are booting but not getting ready due to handshake timeouts. Recent deploy? None in last hour.

elaine-cs: Hearing from cust-137: intermittent streaming stalls, users see 10s+ response pauses. They reported an app timeout.

oncall-sre-mike: Quick checks: routing policy shows traffic was routed to dedicated-eu-1 by cost-tier routing. Can we temporarily route a subset to dedicated-us-1 / fallback model?

runtime-eng-sanjay: Yes. Two immediate mitigations: 1) manual scale up to bring more warm capacity, 2) enable fallback model variant (smaller quantized) for streaming to reduce kernel pressure. I'll run both.

runtime-eng-sanjay: Running manual scale:
```
redwoodctl pool scale --pool dedicated-eu-1 --min 8 --max 30 --now
```

incident-bot: Action recorded: manual scale requested by runtime-eng-sanjay at 4321000015.

infra-ashley: Pushing emergency capacity. Noting that warmup handshake timeout sits at 95s in the logs:
```
[autoscaler] handshake_wait=95s pool=dedicated-eu-1 instance_id=a-12345 status=timeout
```

runtime-eng-sanjay: Observing streaming stalls correlate with high KV cache miss rate during cold handshakes — the KV-cache prewarm didn't run because handshake didn't finish. p99 tokens stalled while cache warmed.

oncall-sre-mike: Short-term routing change: shifting 20% of traffic from dedicated-eu-1 to dedicated-us-1 to relieve tail. Deploying route override now.

runtime-eng-sanjay: Applied route override. Verifying customer impact.

elaine-cs: cust-137 confirms partial relief, still seeing occasional stalls but fewer timeouts. They want ETA for full fix.

product-tasha: Notifying account team for cust-137 and cust-482. Need a brief status update to customers: describe mitigation and ETA.

runtime-eng-sanjay: Added a fallback model route for streaming endpoints for those tenants: smaller-embed-quant model. This reduces per-request GPU memory and avoids the longest kernels.

infra-ashley: New warm instances are coming up but healthchecks stuck at "handshake_pending" due to agent handshake mismatch. Looking at agent logs.

runtime-eng-sanjay: Found handshake regression — recent library change bumped the handshake timeout expectation. Rolling a quick patch to reduce required prewarm steps for warm instances (skip full KV prewarm for emergency scale).

oncall-sre-mike: Good. For tracking: p95 has dropped to ~800ms after route shift & fallback, p99 down to ~2200ms but still above SLO. Queue depth falling from 420 -> 140 over last 2 minutes.

incident-bot: Incident severity escalated to SEV2 at 4321000032 due to >2 customers seeing degraded streaming p99 > SLO.

runtime-eng-sanjay: Patch rolled. Re-initializing warmup; handshake timeouts now ~8s. Instances becoming ready.

infra-ashley: Instances marked ready. Autoscaler logs show warmup_success for 6 instances.

oncall-sre-mike: Observed additional relief: p99 at ~700ms, p95 ~250ms. Streaming stalls largely resolved.

elaine-cs: Customer cust-137 updated: full service returned for most users, will monitor for 30m and report if regressions.

product-tasha: Preparing customer-facing note. ETA for full incident report?

runtime-eng-sanjay: We'll complete initial RCA and next steps within 4 hours. Short-term mitigations: revert routing override, keep new min capacity for 30m, keep fallback model enabled for specific tenants for 60m. Long-term: fix autoscaler handshake regression, add metrics on KV prewarm success and handshake latency, add canary to routing changes.

oncall-sre-mike: Handoff to next oncall in 20m. Documenting runbook steps taken and links to artifacts:
- Scaling command executed by sanjay (see deploy logs)
- Route override id: route-ev-77 applied at 4321000022
- Patch PR: github.com/redwood/infra/pull/2048 (hotfix)

next-oncall-leo: I will take it from here. Please post any outstanding follow-ups and alerts.

runtime-eng-sanjay: Outstanding: correlate which tenants hit fallback model and quantify quality delta. Also recommend increasing warm pool baseline for dedicated-eu-1 by 25% during peak hours until autoscaler fix.

oncall-sre-mike: Done. Closing live mitigation. Marking incident as ongoing for RCA. Paging channel cleared at 4321000105. :white_check_mark:

incident-bot: Note: follow-up tasks created for eng-runtime and infra; tagging owners.
